biomarkers.name: ER, PR, HER2 (on nodal biopsy)
biomarkers.prevalence: Varies by underlying breast cancer subtype; assess on metastatic nodal tissue as per invasive breast cancer
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports breast origin in the appropriate clinicopathologic context and guides systemic therapy

biomarkers.name: GATA3, mammaglobin, GCDFP-15
biomarkers.prevalence: Variable; GATA3 is generally more sensitive than mammaglobin and GCDFP-15 for breast origin
biomarkers.clinical_use: Support breast origin on nodal biopsy

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Diagnosis of exclusion — metastatic nodal biopsy with breast phenotype but no detectable breast primary on clinical exam and conventional imaging
variants: histology follows presumed primary (most often invasive ductal carcinoma / no special type)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Nottingham grade may be applied if morphology is sufficient on nodal metastasis, though grading is primarily validated for the breast primary

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Metastatic carcinoma within lymph node, sometimes with desmoplastic stromal reaction

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Presumed breast epithelial primary that is clinically/radiologically occult
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: As per intrinsic subtype and receptor status
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: No distinct lineage biology — occult presentation is primarily a clinicoradiologic detection issue rather than a separate lineage-defined entity
